name: gizza-ai/css-select-extract
summary: Fetch a page and extract content matching a CSS selector

tool.description: Fetch an http(s) page and extract content from every element matching a CSS selector. Returns a list of matches as their text content, inner HTML, or a named attribute's value.

attr.description: Attribute name to read when extract="attr" (e.g. "href"). Required when extract="attr"; elements lacking it are skipped.

extract.description: What to extract from each matched element: "text" (default) = concatenated text content, "html" = inner HTML, "attr" = the value of the attribute named by "attr".

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (default 100).

selector.description: CSS selector to match elements (e.g. "h2.title", "a", "div#main p").

url.description: Absolute http or https URL of the page to fetch.
